name: IBM Quantum Challenge
description: IBM Quantum Challenge is a biannual global event, run in Spring and Fall, where participants solve quantum computing problems with Qiskit on IBM Quantum's cloud platform. Editions vary in whether they run on real hardware or on simulators — the 2024 challenge focused on software simulation rather than requiring hardware access. Each challenge focuses on different themes such as quantum algorithms, error mitigation, or quantum applications, and is designed for skill levels from beginner to expert.
eligibility: Open to all skill levels worldwide

news.title: IBM Announces 2024 Quantum Challenge Featuring Qiskit 1.0
news.excerpt: IBM launched the 2024 IBM Quantum Challenge (June 5-14, 2024) focusing on the newly released Qiskit 1.0, open to participants of all experience levels. The 2024 challenge emphasizes software simulation rather than hardware execution to accommodate large participant numbers.
